enrichment.headline: Pays Soccer Without Borders up to $30,000 for academic case management at Oakland International High
enrichment.summary: Soccer Without Borders will provide intensive academic case management to students in its existing, separately funded athletic programs at Oakland International High School. Support includes individual and group sessions, case management and social-emotional learning workshops to prevent dropouts and promote healthy choices. The agreement runs August 10 through September 30, 2026, for no more than $30,000. The service period started before this vote.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Pays Soccer Without Borders up to $14,400 for lunchtime skills sessions at Oakland High School
enrichment.summary: Soccer Without Borders will hold twice-weekly lunch sessions on campus for over 30 students at Oakland High School to build social-emotional skills. One curriculum focuses on school participation, attendance and behavior; the other aims to reduce gender violence and improve boys' relationship skills. The agreement runs September 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027, for no more than $14,400. The service period started before this vote.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
